articles.title: Women's Basketball moves to 2-0 with win at Merrimack
articles.summary: NORTH ANDOVER, Mass. -- Five Black Bears scored in double figures as the University of Maine women's basketball team rolled to an 87-62 victory over Merrimack on Sunday afternoon at Lawler Arena. Maine improved to 2-0 for the first time since 2020 behind a balanced offensive effort that produced 12 three-pointers and 19 assists.
